thread:
maya: Pushing int4-v2 to a 1% canary using the synthetic-eval corpus. Quick summary: +0.8% avg ROUGE on long-docs, but a ~2% bump in short-answer hallucinations on sample cohort A. Any redlines we want to apply before scaling?
ajay: 2% hallucination bump is a head-turner. What's our current auto-fallback rule? 
maya: We only had an absolute threshold: hallucination_rate > 3% -> immediate rollback. This would be a relative delta though. 
sasha: Suggest a delta-based gate for onboarded quant models: if delta(hallucination_rate) > 1.0% OR delta(coherence_score) < -0.5% across a monitored slice -> auto-fallback to fp16 baseline.
lina: Also flag if short-answer exact match drops > 1.5% on the named slice. Those are product visible.
ajay: Agreed. Operationally we should require the condition to persist across two 15m windows before triggering to avoid noisy spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed: model=int4-v2, traffic=1%, hosts=10, start_ts=1749015435
devops: routing note: make sure the canary traffic is pinned by user_id hash to avoid heavy tail on repeated users. set route=cohort_hash:mod(100)<1
maya: Running slice check now, posting quick diff of metrics:
```
metric,hist,canary,baseline,delta
hallucination_rate,short_ans,0.042,0.022,+0.020
rouge_avg,long_doc,0.324,0.316,+0.008
exact_match,short_ans,0.811,0.829,-0.018
latency_p95,all,210ms,195ms,+15ms
```
sasha: yikes exact_match drop 1.8% and halluc delta +2.0%. This trips our stricter product gate.
ajay: Given those numbers, we should auto-fallback. But follow lina's persistence rule (2 windows) and then immediate rollback if both windows consistent.
lina: Also create an alert to the model-onboard channel with the metrics snapshot and a link to the eval dashboard.
maya: I'll pause scale-up. Can we automate the fallback action? Currently it's manual.
devops: We have a small adjudicator lambda that can fire rollback if the canary_status endpoint reports a 'TRIP' state. We need to push rule config: 
```
rule:
  name: quant-int4-delta-fallback
  condition: |
    (halluc_delta > 0.01 and exact_match_drop > 0.01) or (halluc_delta > 0.015)
  persistence_windows: 2
  action: rollback_to=fp16-v3
  notify: #eng-ml,#product
```
ajay: Sounds good. Add a cooldown of 30m after rollback to prevent thrash.
sasha: And add a soft-stop that prevents auto-scale beyond 5% unless canary runs for 6 hours with stable metrics.
maya: Fine by me. I'll open a config PR and tag infra. Will also attach the eval slices and the seed prompts we used.
deploy-bot: Canary monitor: window1 checked at 1749015460 -> TRIP
maya: Ok that's one window. Waiting on window2 (next 15m)
ajay: If window2 also TRIP, lambda should execute rollback and post to #model-onboard with artifact links.
lina: After rollback, we should collect a random 500-case sandbox from failed requests for manual triage.
maya: noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 — contains rule + alert config.
ajay: I'll merge and deploy the lambda rule once maya confirms window2.
maya: window2 also TRIP. Initiating manual rollback now as interim, lambda will be live after merge. rolling back to fp16-v3. 
deploy-bot: Rollback executed: target=fp16-v3, at=1749015490, initiated_by=maya
sasha: Postmortem checklist: add synthetic slice enrichment, augment training set if failure is data-related, retrain candidate quant with additional calibration.
lina: Good. Also add a canary-smoke test that checks exact_match on canonical short answers before promoting.
maya: Thanks team. Filing a short follow-up doc with repro steps and the 500-case sample.
ajay: :thumbsup:
